verdict.rationale: Superset documents taking over and redirecting agent work. Automation output is a live workspace you can 'open, review, and continue interactively.' You can send feedback to a running agent session from selected diff lines. Workspaces include terminals and a browser pane whose Design tool sends element-context changes to an agent. Coverage is not complete: there is no evidence of handing a task off into your own external editor, and the browser pane is used to steer the agent rather than to take over the work. Missing for 10: documented takeover into an external editor/IDE, explicit manual takeover of a running agent's terminal session, a browser-based (web/remote) takeover surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of the takeover workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: the output is a live workspace you (or a teammate) can open, review, and continue interactively
select diff lines, and send feedback to a running or new agent session
Use **Design** in the browser pane to select an element and send your requested change to an agent with element context.
Run Claude Code, Codex, or another CLI agent with terminals, code review, and browser previews in one workspace.
get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input
